sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM("name")) > 0), "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("type" IN ('weight_reps', 'bodyweight', 'timed')), "category" TEXT NULL CHECK("category" IN ('chest', 'back', 'legs', 'shoulders', 'arms', 'core', 'full_body', 'other')), "increment_kg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5 CHECK("increment_kg" > 0.0), "rest_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rest_sec" >= 0), "include_in_strength_index" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("include_in_strength_index" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM("name")) > 0), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("target_sets" BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "target_reps" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_reps" >= 1), "target_duration_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_duration_sec" >= 1), "rest_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rest_sec" >= 0), UNIQUE ("plan_id", "exercise_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES plans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "plan_name_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("target_sets" >= 1), "target_reps" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_reps" >= 1), "target_duration_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_duration_sec" >= 1), "rest_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rest_sec" >= 0), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('pending', 'active', 'done', 'skipped')), "completed_at" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("session_id", "exercise_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "set_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES session_exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "set_index" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("set_index" >= 1), "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL CHECK("reps" >= 1), "duration_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("duration_sec" >= 1), "is_warmup" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_warmup" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_weight_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("date") = 10) UNIQUE, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("weight_kg" > 0.0), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "default_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3 CHECK("default_sets" BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "default_rest_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 90 CHECK("default_rest_sec" >= 0), "rest_timer_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("rest_timer_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "vibration_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("vibration_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "keep_screen_on" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("keep_screen_on" IN (0, 1)), "auto_activate_next" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_activate_next" IN (0, 1)), "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system' CHECK("theme_mode" IN ('system', 'light', 'dark')), "last_selected_plan_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES plans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "last_backup_at" TEXT NULL, "backup_reminder_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 14 CHECK("backup_reminder_days" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX exercises_name_unique ON exercises (name COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX plans_name_unique ON plans (name COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE INDEX plan_exercises_plan ON plan_exercises (plan_id, position)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sessions_single_active ON sessions ((ended_at IS NULL)) WHERE ended_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX session_exercises_session ON session_exercises (session_id, position)
CREATE INDEX set_entries_session_exercise ON set_entries (session_exercise_id, set_index)
